spans.s: vāka, pl. (ºāḥ) (“recitations”): XII, 1613 (yaṃ vākeshv anuvākeshu…gṛṇanti, sc. Kṛshṇa).

Vakra, one or more princes. § 233 (Svayaṃvarap.): I, 187, †7019 (present at the svayaṃvara of Draupadī); 188, †7051 (do., C. has by error ºktrº).--§ 273 (Rājasūyārambhap.): II, 14, 575 (Karūshādhipatiḥ?, had joined Jarāsandha).--§ 567 (Bhagavadyānap.): V, 130, 4411 (had been slain by Kṛshṇa).--§ 621 (Rājadh.): XII, 4, 113 (came to the svayaṃvara of the daughter of the Kaliṅga king Citrāṅgada). Cf. Dantavakra (?), Karūshādhipati (?).
Vakradanta: II, 577 (so B., instead of Dantavakra, q.v.).
Vakrātapa, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 574 (Jambūkh.): VI, 9, 352 (only C., B. has Cakrātayaḥ).
